comment: Coverage floors for the CI coverage job (regression floors, ~1-1.5 points below measured, not tier targets; raise as coverage climbs). Mirrored into the coverage:check npm script in package.json and guarded by test/unit/coverage-thresholds-sync.test.js. Re-measured 2026-08-14 WITH the declared siblings checked out, which is what the coverage job now does: 95.47 lines/statements, 84.11 branches, 87.78 functions over 3731 unit tests (3572 without siblings).
